'''Seelana's Droids''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] shop in the village [[Tathin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] that operated during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The business had an arrangement with the droid [[Merchant/Legends|seller]] [[Joh]] whereby Joh would fulfill droid orders placed in the shop.<ref name="Shadows in Green" /> Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[Shadows in Green]]'' can hence be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> during celebrations surrounding the [[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]] podracing event, Joh was present in the shop and various patrons visited the establishment.<ref name="Shadows in Green" />
